! Title: Tripwire test list
! Homepage: demo/links.html
! A small made-up list in the same format as the real ones. It is loaded only
! in a development install, so the demo page can show blocklist hits without
! depending on what the live lists contain today.
!
! Its entries use reserved names (.example, .test, a documentation IP range)
! that can't be real sites, plus specific made-up paths on three real hosts
! to exercise path matching.
!
! --- Whole hosts ---
blocklisted-phish.example
malware-drop.test
203.0.113.77
!
! --- Whole-host entries that must be IGNORED ---
! A list must never turn every link to these red:
github.com
sites.google.com
docs.google.com
github.io
bit.ly
gov.in
list-manage.com
co.uk
192.168.1.1
!
! --- One address on a host ---
||shared-files.example/users/mallory/^$all
||sites.google.com/view/tripwire-test-phish/^$all
||bit.ly/tripwire-test-phish^$all
||downloads.example/get.php?id=42^$all
||files.example:8443/payload.bin^$all
!
! --- For the demo page's "trusted domain that is on a blocklist" case ---
||partner-portal.example/files/invoice.html^$all
!
! --- The demo page itself, at one address ---
! Open http://listed.localhost:8080/demo to see a page that is itself listed.
||listed.localhost:8080/demo^$all
!
! --- Entries the parser skips ---
||wild*card.example/anything^$all
